title: read_file guesses wrong extension for signal catalogue file causing tool error
description: During post-compaction context re-establishment in run 7588055a, the agent attempted read_file on .moeb/signals/catalogue/a1000104-0612-4000-8000-000000000104.signal.md but the actual file extension is .signal.json. The moeb read_file tool returned a cannot-read error. The agent then attempted an absolute path read which was rejected as outside allowed roots. Signal catalogue files consistently use the .signal.json extension; the .signal.md extension does not exist in the catalogue.
proposed_resolution: When a signal catalogue file path needs to be re-discovered (e.g. after compaction), use search_files with pattern '<signal_id>*.signal.json' under .moeb/signals/catalogue/, or grep_files on .moeb/signals/index.md to extract the File column value for the signal UUID. Do not construct the path with an assumed extension.
